left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Grade IV Glioblastoma, receiving chemotherapy  [OR] with or without TTfields

-  Progressive  [OR] or recurrent disease requiring second line treatment
  -  evidence of progression of disease by brain MRI  [AND] and are planned to receive chemotherapy
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Current use of another beta blocker that cannot be switched to carvedilol at the onset of the trial

right.raw_text:
-  Systolic blood pressure  [OR] <90 mmHg and/or heart rate <60 bpm without hypertensive medications
  -  Allergy to beta blockers
  -  Severe  [OR] or uncontrolled asthma  [OR] or COPD (chronic obstructive pulmonary disease)
